convert_video_instances_to_3d: convert video instance segmentation data into 3D-compatible masks and class labels
create_video_instance_masks: create padded instance masks from per-frame detection targets across multiple video frames
filter_video_instances_by_class: filter video instances by skipping specified class IDs during conversion
generate_point_semantic_labels: generate per-pixel point semantic instance labels combining class and instance IDs
build_video_target_dict: build a target dictionary with instance masks, class labels, and optional point semantic labels
